Name: Animal Hat Pans
Author: NaoeaDri
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z5GvUWW.png[/img]

1. Download [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
﻿3. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)
4. Download this mod and unzip in your mods folder
5. First run the game using SMAPI to create the config.json file
6. Configure the mod however you like in the Mod Config Menu in the lower left corner of the home screen.

If you chose not to use the Generic Mod Config Menu, you need to close the game and open the Config.json file to make the settings, and once you finished you can open the game again.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/hNRgvFo.png[/img]

﻿I created this mod because I would like to use the game's pans more, but they look very ugly like hats when put on your head, so [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21139]Froggy Bucket Hat[/url] inspired me.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/fEhTgKb.png[/img]

[b]Copper Pan[/b]: Bear, Cow, Crow, Duck, Frog, Pig or Raccoon;

[b]Steel Pan[/b]: Bear, Cow, Crow, Duck, Frog, Pig or Raccoon;

[b]Gold Pan[/b]: Bear, Cow, Crow, Duck, Frog, Pig or Raccoon;

[b]Iridium Pan[/b]: Bear, Cow, Crow, Duck, Frog, Pig or Raccoon;

You can set any of these pans to "False" to disable the retexture individually.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/caHRAXF.png[/img]
